title: Use HDMI-CEC to turn on connected HDMI screens on session start
line: TVs used as screens get an opt-in "HDMI-CEC" checkbox in Display Configuration that turns the TV on and switches it to the computer when the screen turns on.
explanation: Nothing in Plasma used HDMI-CEC, so a TV used as a monitor stayed in standby when the session started, although the GPU exposes a CEC adapter (/dev/cecN) for that HDMI/DP connector and other devices wake TVs with CEC One Touch Play. Earlier versions of this fix sent it on every wake with no opt-out, then looked for the adapter by opening every /dev/cec* each time KWin re-checked an output's capabilities (on the compositor's main thread) and never noticed an adapter that registers after the screen, as DP-CEC does once the TV's EDID is read. Now KWin's DRM backend keeps a list of CEC adapters and their connectors, filled once through udev and updated on cec add/remove uevents, and updates an output's HDMI-CEC capability when its adapter comes or goes. A per-output setting (off by default, saved by KWin, carried by kde-output-device/management, libkscreen and kscreen-doctor) shows as an "HDMI-CEC" checkbox in Display Configuration; only when it's on does KWin send Image View On and Active Source as the output turns on, from a worker thread, claiming a logical address just for those messages and releasing it right after.

commits.message:
kde-output-{device,management}: add HDMI-CEC One Touch Play setting

Compositors can turn on a TV and switch it to their input over HDMI-CEC,
but that takes the TV away from whatever the user is watching, so it has
to be a choice per output. Add a capability, event and request for it.

BUG: 524509

backends/drm: add an opt-in HDMI-CEC One Touch Play setting

TVs used as monitors stayed off when the session started, as KWin never
talked to them over HDMI-CEC. Outputs with a CEC adapter now have a
setting, off by default, to turn the TV on and switch it to our input.

BUG: 524509

output: add a setting for HDMI-CEC One Touch Play

KWin can turn on a TV and switch it to this computer over HDMI-CEC when
an output turns on, if the user wants it to. Expose that setting and its
capability per output, and let kscreen-doctor show and change it.

BUG: 524509

kcm: add a checkbox for HDMI-CEC One Touch Play

KWin can turn on a TV used as a screen and switch it to this computer
over HDMI-CEC, but that also takes the TV away from what is on it. Show
an opt-in checkbox for outputs that have an HDMI-CEC adapter.

BUG: 524509

2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Display Configuration has no HDMI-CEC option; nothing in Plasma talks to the TV.

With the fix: an opt-in "HDMI-CEC" checkbox for outputs that have a CEC adapter (the rig has no CEC hardware, so for this shot its virtual output was made to report one). Ticking it and pressing Apply saves it in KWin and it survives a session restart.
Master: KWin's real DRM backend (mock DRM test) enables, wakes and re-enables the output; the fake CEC adapter on that connector receives nothing.

With the fix, same kind of run: nothing is sent while the setting is off (the default). With it on, KWin wakes the TV at session start and on wake from screen-off, then releases the address it claimed; it reuses an address another program set up, and falls back to an unregistered Image View On if it can't get one.

Previous version of the fix, KWin mock DRM test with a fake CEC adapter: /dev/cec0 is opened 13 times just for enabling, DPMS and connector re-probes, and an adapter that appears or disappears after the screen is never noticed.
With the rework, same test: the adapter is read once at startup and on udev add/remove, the HDMI-CEC capability follows it, and nothing is opened until One Touch Play is actually sent.

Display Configuration while the screen has no CEC adapter yet (DP-CEC registers it only after reading the TV's EDID): no HDMI-CEC row. With the previous version the row stayed missing after the adapter appeared.

With the rework (rig, where the virtual screen is made to gain and lose a CEC adapter): the HDMI-CEC row appears, disappears and comes back live as the adapter comes and goes, without reopening the page.

review.text: The design is right for KWin: an opt-in per-output setting carried through the protocol, libkscreen and the KCM, and the CEC address is released after use. But DrmOutput::computeCapabilities(), which runs on every hotplug and every output config apply, now scans and opens every /dev/cec* on the compositor's main thread. A CEC adapter that registers after the connector (DP-CEC registers once the sink's EDID is read) is also never noticed. The fix was only checked against a mocked adapter and has never run on a real TV, so the CEC messages and the claim/release timing are unproven.
changes: Find the CEC adapter once per connector through KWin's Udev class (cec subsystem, connector info) and cache it, refreshing on cec add/remove uevents. Don't scan /dev/cec* inside computeCapabilities().
Update the HdmiCec capability when an adapter appears or disappears after the output was created.
Test One Touch Play on real CEC hardware (or the vivid virtual CEC driver) before submitting, and raise the design with KWin developers on the bug or MR.
